gen-comfortaa-gf-fenix: Friendly and geometric, Comfortaa draws every stroke like bent neon tubing. And Fenix, a classic serif, brings editorial curves whose ends stop before they turn inward, which is the real draw of this pairing.
gen-comfortaa-gf-gentium-plus: Comfortaa makes a ring of its c and holds every line to a single width, like bent wire. And Gentium Plus, a serif with a wide pitcher mouth in each c, can take a slightly larger size.
gen-comfortaa-gf-habibi: Round, bright and wire-bent, that is Comfortaa up top, with spacing stretched like a loose spring. Then Habibi, a serif with a clear channel leading into each round letter, gives the page a traditional editorial footing beneath it.
gen-comfortaa-gf-inika: Inika, a serif with a see-through gap in every s, sits beneath a heading drawn with steady pen pressure from start to finish. Its strongest quality is that classic, traditional feel.
gen-comfortaa-gf-kay-pho-du: Neon-tube roundness meets old-school type. Comfortaa leads with its ring-shaped c, and Kay Pho Du, a text serif with hollow-reed counters and a rolling-ball-pen trail, brings the traditional weight that anchors it.
gen-comfortaa-gf-labrada: Labrada is a dignified, bookish serif with wide openings on its small letters, set under a heading with joins as thick as its strokes. Comfortaa supplies the friendly geometry.
gen-comfortaa-gf-laila: Laila, a serif with generous space between its curve ends and the stem, has a traditional editorial look. And paragraphs in it would move easily, while Comfortaa's uniform strokes up top keep things friendly.
gen-comfortaa-gf-montaga: Comfortaa stretches its spacing like an uncoiled spring, with a ring-shaped c and no thinning anywhere in its curves. Montaga, a text serif with pen-lifted loops, supplies the bookish side.
gen-comfortaa-gf-new-tegomin: New Tegomin reads dignified and traditional, with a wide-open ring for a c. Comfortaa is best at friendly, thinning-free curves in big display lettering, while the serif does its best work in steady, bookish text.
gen-comfortaa-gf-podkova: Pipe-cleaner curves meet a bookish face. Comfortaa leads with that wire-like roundness, and Podkova, a text serif with a broad welcoming c, may be nudged a little larger to hold its own.
